charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_0200:
Hmm... Even after all that research, Palkia
is still full of mysteries.
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_0300:
Yeah... I want a deeper understanding
of it, too.
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_0500:
I was just talking to Irida so I could learn
more about Palkia!
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_0600:
Mighty Palkia is shrouded in mystery. Even
among the Pearl Clan, much is still unknown.
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_0700:
According to legends, mighty Palkia created
the space of this world.
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_0800:
If it has power like that, maybe some other
force is behind its change in form, too.
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_0900:
When you think about it, Palkia truly is an
incredible Pokémon.
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_1000: I’m honored to be its partner!
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_1100:
I also feel a strong sense of responsibility,
though.
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_0301_1200:
Must be your role as a
Neo Champion...
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_0401_1300:
Yeah! I’m ready to face it head-on
with Palkia!
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_0302_1400: I’m sure you can handle it!
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_0402_1500: Thanks! I’m happy to hear you say that.
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_1600: I don’t just want to win battles.
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_1700: I want to lead people and Pokémon, too!
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_1800:
But I can’t seem to do much about how
scatterbrained I am.
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_1900:
The other day, I dropped something and
couldn’t find it, no matter where I looked.
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_2000: Then suddenly, Palkia found it for me!
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_2100:
I like to think Palkia helping me like that is
proof it believes in me.
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_2200:
So I need to work even harder to live up to
its expectations!
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_2300:
Those feelings must be why you became a
Neo Champion, Dawn!
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_2500:
As a Neo Champion with Palkia by my side,
I’m going to give it my all like never before!
charaepi_ch0116_90_hikari/2301_1201_2600: I hope you both see what we accomplish!
